name: A1-R0 Weather Monitor Probe
description: The A1-R0 Weather Monitor Probe was a type of probe droid used by the Selkath species on the planet Manaan during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. The A1-R0 Probe was used to monitor the surface weather of the planet at surface installations such as the upper section of Genetics Laboratory G-1.
